title: Lyft and DoorDash Launch New $10 Monthly Subscription Bundle
excerpt: DoorDash's DashPass now includes Lyft Go at no additional cost as part of a new $10 monthly subscription bundle.
body_html: Lyft and DoorDash have introduced a new subscription bundle priced at $10 per month. Through this offering, members of DoorDash's DashPass subscription service gain access to Lyft Go at no extra cost.
